lines.en: I trudge through snow, one pit per step.
My short trunk swings about.
I keep beside my mother's legs.
Frost has crusted on my fuzz.
My ears are small; they don't cool much.
I wade through a snowdrift.
I step in the tracks ahead.
I move slowly through the conifers.
I shake my trunk.
The snow is deep; every step costs me.
I stop and push at the snow.
I look up at my mother's back.
I miss a step and sink in.
I pull one leg free of the snow.
Snow beads hang in my fuzz.
I lean on my mother's leg for warmth.
I press close to my mother.
I curl my trunk into my mouth.
The wind is strong here.
I haven't grown tusks yet.
Snow settles on my back.
I hear a noise in the trees.
I stamp twice.
My fur is softer than the grown ones'.
I wait for them to move on.
When the wind stops, it's not so cold.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅空气，没别的味道。
lines.en: I sniff the air. Nothing else.
I tuck my head down.
My shadow on the snow is small.
You crouched. Now I can see you.
You're much smaller than my mother.
I'm not afraid, but I won't come close.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子能闻出你的味道。
lines.en: My trunk can pick out your smell.

lines.zh: 我跟着母亲，毛还没长齐。
lines.en: I follow my mother, coat still thin.
My mother is watching. I know.
Your bootprints are deep in the snow.
I tilt my head and glance at you.
I back away, stepping in my mother's prints.
I fall into the snow.
My fuzz is caught.
The pain makes my trunk droop.
I duck behind my mother's legs.

lines.zh: 雪落了一地，毛还是暖的。
lines.en: Snow falls off me; my coat stays warm.

lines.zh: 这么小的我，你也下得去手。
lines.en: I'm this small, and you'd still hit me.
I limp away.
I'm panting fast.

lines.zh: 四条短腿扎进雪里，没倒。
lines.en: Four short legs dig into the snow - I'm still up.
I touch it with my trunk first.
My mother hasn't said no.
I take a small piece.
This isn't cold. Good.
I want more, but I daren't.
You're teasing. I can tell.
Done eating, I look up at you.
The grass in your hand is out of my reach.
I bump your leg and bounce off.
I plop down in the snow.
The snow takes a dent from me.
I get up and shake.
You touch my ear; I shake my head.
I shift aside to let you pass.
My mother nudges me back.
A knock like that doesn't scare me.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子碰到你的手了。
lines.en: My trunk touched your hand.
Snow gets into my fur.
Another calf is nearby.
We roll in the snow together.
It hides behind its own mother.
We walk side by side.
It tries to swing its trunk and fails.
Snow falls; we huddle.
The grown ones call us back.
Tomorrow, the same snow slope.
I curl it up with my trunk.
Too slippery; it drops.
I step and sink into the snow.
My mother pushes that thing away.
I bury the pearl in the snow.
I try to lift it; it's heavy.
I kick at what fell.
I reach my trunk into the hollow.
I pick up a branch.
I drag it two steps.
There's a noise over there.
I hide behind my mother's legs.
I raise my head and listen.
That's not a smell I know.
I stamp to call them over.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向顶了一下。
lines.en: I push toward that direction.
My trunk is up.
Something's moving in the snow.

lines.zh: 我躲在母象腿后面看你。
lines.en: I peek at you from behind my mother's legs.
I back to my mother's side.
I won't run. I'll stand.
I've taken this step.
It's still there. I'm watching.
I stay behind my mother.
The snow hides it.
My mother has stepped forward.
I follow her.
I go around to the other side to look.
The smell grows closer.
I stamp to tell them.
I point my trunk that way.
I hug the snow and make no sound.
I wait for the grown ones.
The snow is deep; it can't move fast.
I put my whole body into it.
My trunk lashes out.
I copy what my mother does.
You stepped back; I keep pushing.
I stamp hard.
That threw up the snow.
I'm knocked over and roll.
I get up and charge again.
My strength isn't much yet.
The grown ones watch behind me.

lines.zh: 雪堆塌了一角，我露出来。
lines.en: A corner of the snowbank caves in and there I am.
My mother's legs are right there.
I shake and the frost falls off.
This is my first snow.
First I hunch my neck.
The trees are dense; the wind is less.
One step and the snow reaches my knees.
I smell pine needles.
My trunk tip pokes out of the burrow first.
I press against my mother for warmth.
This is colder than the den.
I swing my trunk.

lines.zh: 火把我的绒毛燎了一截。
lines.en: Fire singes a stretch of my fuzz.
I land in snow. It's soft.
Cold water fills my trunk; I kick.
The bang knocks me into a sit.
A flash and I'm dazed.
My belly is flat against my ribs; my legs wobble.
Thunder so loud I lie down.
I fall, and the snow is gone.
